missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Газета' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Свежая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на столе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Газету' is the accusative direct object of 'читаю'. 'Утром' is an instrumental adverb of time, anchoring a daily routine.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. 'Газеты' is the genitive form after the preposition 'из', showing the source. 'Вчерашней' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Газету' is the accusative after 'в', marking the destination of the news. 'Новость' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'над'. 'Газетой' is the instrumental form after 'над', expressing what one works on. 'Школьной' agrees in the feminine instrumental.

missions.phrase: Я прочитал об этом в газете.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В газете' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to express where something was read. 'Об этом' adds the topic.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Газете' is the dative form marking the newspaper as the recipient. 'Статью' is the accusative object of 'отдал'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Газеты' is the accusative plural object of 'продают'; for inanimate nouns it equals the nominative plural. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Газет' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'Подписан на' takes the accusative frame, with the count noun driving the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Газеты' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'В киоске' is the prepositional location, and 'сегодня' adds time.
